44366236.name: Difludiazepam
44366236.description: Difludiazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative which is the 2',6'-difluoro derivative of fludiazepam.

53242268.name: CU-CPT4a
53242268.description: CU-CPT4a is a drug which acts as a selective antagonist of Toll-like receptor 3 , with an IC50 of 3.44 μM.

53395228.name: Magnesium L-threonate
53395228.description: Magnesium L-threonate is a magnesium salt of L-threonic acid having the formula Mg 2.

53439004.name: Vat Blue 36
53439004.description: Vat Blue 36 is a vat dye that is chemically related to indigo. It is produced by condensation of 4-methyl-5-chloro-7-methoxy-3-indolinone and 5,7–dichloro-3- -thianaphthenone.

56841116.name: Budesonide/formoterol
56841116.description: Budesonide/formoterol, sold under the brand name Symbicort among others, is a fixed-dose combination medication used in the management of asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease .

57468316.name: 5-Ethoxy-DMT
57468316.description: 5-Ethoxy-DMT, or 5-EtO-DMT, also known as 5-ethoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine or as O-ethylbufotenine, is a tryptamine derivative which has been previously synthesized as a chemical intermediate, but has...

59744668.name: Cendifensine
59744668.description: Cendifensine (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name) is a monoamine reuptake inhibitor related to the amphetamines and cathinones which has not been marketed at this time.

69456028.name: MBM (drug)
69456028.description: MBM, also known as 2,5-dimethoxy-4-butoxyamphetamine or as TMA2-4-BuO, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families.

72163100.name: Atogepant
72163100.description: Atogepant, sold under the brand name Qulipta among others, is a medication used to prevent migraines.

73357724.name: Lead metagermanate
73357724.description: Lead metagermante is one of the germanates of lead with the chemical formula of PbGeO3. Other germanates include Pb5Ge3O11.

75295900.name: DragonFLY
75295900.description: DragonFLY, also known as DFLY or H-DFLY, is a serotonin receptor agonist of the phenethylamine, DOx, and FLY families. It is the "dragonFLY" analogue of 2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine .

76287260.name: Darigabat
76287260.description: Darigabat (developmental code names CVL-865, PF-06372865, PF-6372865) is a GABAergic medication which is under development for the treatment of photosensitive epilepsy, focal onset seizures, panic...

87766684.name: Neptunium(IV) oxalate
87766684.description: Neptunium oxalate is a chemical compound made up of neptunium and oxalate ions with the formula Np 2.

90408860.name: JNJ-55308942
90408860.description: JNJ-55308942 is an investigational drug that works as a P2X7 antagonist with a downstream effect of reducing interleukin-1β release. It is developed by Janssen Pharmaceuticals for bipolar depression.

118253852.name: Brensocatib
118253852.description: Brensocatib, sold under the brand name Brinsupri, is a medication used for the treatment of bronchiectasis.

118613788.name: Cofrogliptin
118613788.description: Cofrogliptin is a long-acting DPP4 inhibitor dosed once every two weeks.

118797980.name: Linopristin/flopristin
118797980.description: Linopristin/flopristin is an experimental drug candidate under development by Novexel.

129406620.name: ADB-BINACA
129406620.description: ADB-BINACA (also known as ADMB-BZINACA using EMCDDA naming standards) is a cannabinoid designer drug that has been found as an ingredient in some synthetic cannabis products.

131750172.name: Glucose/fructose/phosphoric acid
131750172.description: Glucose/fructose/phosphoric acid is an over-the-counter antiemetic taken to relieve nausea and vomiting.

133082268.name: Org 6582
133082268.description: Org 6582 is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor which was never marketed. It is an analogue of para-chloroamphetamine and 6-chloro-2-aminotetralin .

135398684.name: Vargulin
135398684.description: Vargulin, also called Cypridinid luciferin, Cypridina luciferin, or Vargula luciferin, is the luciferin found in the ostracod Cypridina hilgendorfii, also named Vargula hilgendorfii.

135414428.name: Mordant brown 33
135414428.description: Mordant brown 33 is 2,4-diamino-5- benzene sulfonic acid sodium salt.

135465884.name: CGS-13767
135465884.description: CGS-13767 is an anxiolytic GABA receptor ligand.

135565852.name: Glucosepane
135565852.description: Glucosepane is a lysine-arginine protein cross-linking product and advanced glycation end product derived from D-glucose.

137083676.name: Lesinurad/allopurinol
137083676.description: Lesinurad/allopurinol is a fixed-dose combination drug for the treatment of gout.

154694300.name: Noribogainalog
154694300.description: Noribogainalog , also known as 9-hydroxyibogaminalog or as GATC-021, is a drug of the ibogalog family related to noribogaine. It is a simplified analogue of noribogaine.

162368540.name: 1V-LSD
162368540.description: 1V-LSD, also known as 1-valeryl-LSD or by the nickname Valerie, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

900000028.name: 2C-B-3PIP-NBOMe
900000028.description: 2C-B-3PIP-NBOMe is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, 2C, 3-phenylpiperidine , and NBOMe families.

900000156.name: Ammonium hexabromostannate(IV)
900000156.description: Ammonium hexabromostannate is an inorganic chemical compound with the chemical formula 2SnBr6.

900000796.name: Evinacumab
900000796.description: Evinacumab, sold under the brand name Evkeeza, is a monoclonal antibody medication for the treatment of homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia .

900000924.name: Hafnium phosphide
900000924.description: Hafnium phosphide is a binary inorganic compound of hafnium metal and phosphorus.

900001052.name: Isopropylmalic acid
900001052.description: Isopropylmalic acid is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of leucine.

900001308.name: NEtPhOH-THPI
900001308.description: NEtPhOH-THPI, also known as N′- -THPI, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist and possible serotonergic psychedelic of the tetrahydropyridinylindole family related to psychedelic tryptamines.

900001436.name: Orthonitrate
900001436.description: Orthonitrate is a tetrahedral anion of nitrogen with the formula NO43−.

900001564.name: Pleuran
900001564.description: Pleuran is an insoluble polysaccharide (β- -D-glucan), isolated from Pleurotus ostreatus.

900001692.name: Potassium polonide
900001692.description: Potassium polonide is a chemical compound with the formula K2Po. It is a polonide, a set of very chemically stable compounds of polonium.

900001948.name: TGF-8027
900001948.description: TGF-8027, or TGF-8-027, also known as N-[1- ethyl]-2,5-dimethoxy-4-cyanophenethylamine, is a highly selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and putative serotonergic psychedelic of the...

900002076.name: Triiodine fluorosulfate
900002076.description: Triiodine fluorosulfate is the inorganic compound with the chemical formula I3SO3F. It is the fluorosulfate salt of the I+3 polyhalogen ion.

900002204.name: Zenagamtide
900002204.description: Amycretin/Zenagamtide is a single molecule that operates as a GLP-1 receptor agonist and amylin receptor agonist.
